items.text: Afternoon Tea Club

items.speaker: Gluttonous Critters
items.text: Dearest club members! Let's see now. What do we get on our spread? What's here? What's here?

items.speaker: Gluttonous Critter I
items.text: Smoked salmon!

items.speaker: Gluttonous Critter II
items.text: Scones with blueberry jam!

items.speaker: Gluttonous Critter III
items.text: Chocolate and hazelnut cupcakes!

items.speaker: Gluttonous Critters
items.text: Fantastic! Afternoon tea time! Afternoon tea time!

items.speaker: Gluttonous Critters
items.text: What else is there to nibble on?

items.speaker: Gluttonous Critter I
items.text: Deviled eggs!

items.speaker: Gluttonous Critter IV
items.text: Pea soup!

items.speaker: Gluttonous Critter III
items.text: Pistachio macarons!

items.speaker: Gluttonous Critters
items.text: Fantastic! Afternoon tea time! Wait ... What?!

items.speaker: Gluttonous Critters
items.text: Nobody likes pea soup here. Get it gone! Get it out! Get it out!

items.speaker: Gluttonous Critter IV
items.text: Ugh?! Yucky, yucky, yuck!
Flutterpage and Lamplighter stare in disbelief as the unfortunate critter with the pea soup is seized and thrown out by the rest.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Hey, what a waste! Pea soup ain't my favorite neither, but you shouldn't be chuckin' out good food like that!

items.speaker: Lamplighter
items.text: Those little things? They've always been like this. Don't let their size fool you. They're the wealthiest critters on all of Cross Street.

items.speaker: Gluttonous Critters
items.text: Only the most scrumptious delights deserve a spot at our table! Sit down! Sit down!

items.speaker: Gluttonous Critters
items.text: All friends of the Administrator are more than welcome to share in our feast! Share in our feast!

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Thank you, but we'll have to give it a miss this time. We're actually looking for somethin'. It's ...
The gluttonous critters exchange looks of confusion and panic, cutting Flutterpage off before she can finish.

items.speaker: Gluttonous Critters
items.text: What are you talking about? Something valuable? Don't look at us. We've got nothing like that here—nothing like that!

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: No, no, no. It's not valuable on its own, but it might be inside somethin' you hold dear.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Reckon you might've seen it?
The critters huddle together, murmuring amongst themselves.

items.speaker: Gluttonous Critters
items.text: You're after our dearest possession, aren't you? Aren't you?!

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: No, no! I'm just askin' if you'd take a peek for me. Maybe what I'm after's hidden somewhere inside your dearest possession.

items.speaker: Gluttonous Critters
items.text: Our dearest possession? Okay! We'll give it to you! Give it to you!

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Huh?
For a second, Flutterpage is stunned, but soon her expression softens into a bright smile.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Is that true then? That's so nice of you!

items.speaker: Gluttonous Critters
items.text: But you'll have to pay for it! In cash! In cash!

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Oh ...

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Cash.
Flutterpage is stunned by the absurdity of it all. The huddle of plump critters stare out at her expectantly.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Alright, I s'pose it's only fair. Can't just go 'round asking favors for free.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: How much were you expecting?

items.speaker: Gluttonous Critters
items.text: Much obliged! Return any time! Come back soon! Come back soon!

items.speaker: Lamplighter
items.text: You know, I reckon you could've bargained with those little critters.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Well, it's a bit late to say that now, ain't it? Why didn't you say somethin' earlier?

items.speaker: Lamplighter
items.text: I do apologize. I'm not very good at bargaining myself.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Don't worry about it. I'm the one who messed up.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: You've stuck by me through all this without askin' for so much as a penny. That's more than just being a good mate. Thank you, Lamplighter. You're a true pal.

items.speaker: Lamplighter
items.text: Don't be silly! I'd never ask you for money!
With a weary sigh, Flutterpage inspects the critters' so-called "dearest possession," which cost her so much money.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Anyways ...

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: You reckon this really is their most dearest possession?

items.speaker: Lamplighter
items.text: Erm, I can't rightly say.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Sarah's gonna kill me if she ever finds out I blew all our dosh on a bloomin' stone.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Hm?

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Who's Sarah?

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Oh!

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: That's right! She's my sister. I remember now.
The dim light of the fireflies flickers around them as Flutterpage struggles to piece together the true meaning of that name.
Yet just as quickly, her thoughts are consumed again by a chaotic void.

items.speaker: Lamplighter
items.text: Flutterpage, you ...

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: I know.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: That ain't a good sign, is it?
